source: TODO.md ("엔진 vs 사이트 규칙 불일치") and TRIAGE.md (2026-09-19 and 2026-09-27 sections)
notes: Keys are card ids (parity-actions/parity-apply byAction keys without the 'card:' prefix; parity-playout byCause keys after 'after '). 'move' = a plain move, not a card.

A mismatch is NEW when its key is not listed here. A listed key still counts as 'increased' when its count with the new worker exceeds the count with the previous worker by more than max(min, ratio*old) in the same test.
humanThreshold: update-site.js says 'human review required' when new + increased mismatches reach this number (adjustable). Engine porting can be batched.
When a mismatch is fixed or accepted, edit this file (add/remove ids) and keep the reason short.

known.recurrence: target coordinates differ (engine vs site); old, unrelated to the 2026-09-27 update
known.blackMagic: card exposure at game start differs
known.zugzwang: engine allows the card more often than the site
known.brutus: betrayal: the site uses a move-restriction filter and parrotBaseMoves argument
known.locustSwarm: OPENING card; the site worker has no in-game effect, engine applies it (expected)
known.move: AMBIGUOUS bucket: plain-move divergences (brutus-betrayal restriction, collapse/king timing, engine forceWorkerTurnEnd simpler than the site: thief/protection ticks). Watched through the 'increased' rule only.
known.start: AMBIGUOUS bucket (parity-playout): the action lists already differ before the first ply (initial hand: blackMagic exposure at game start, zugzwang, falseStart...). Watched through the 'increased' rule only.
